chat_translation_handoff.instruction: Read the terminology supplement, style supplement, prior continuity supplement, and current continuity supplement before translating later chapters. The current continuity supplement now extends through Chapter 1243. Preserve one target paragraph per source paragraph, italicize explicit and unmistakable implicit internal thought, capitalize True Self, choose Variable or Variables according to whether the source means one individual or multiple/the general class, preserve Chinese idioms and classical allusions with their defining imagery, and keep chapter prose in chat unless the owner explicitly requests repository chapter files. In particular, retain the donkey in 黔驴技穷 rather than flattening it into a generic paraphrase. Do not add pending terms to the canonical glossary until the owner approves or corrects them.
